name: Reflected Desires
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to shroud the mirror without looking at it, or DC 17 Occultism check (trained) to erect mental barriers

items.name: Tempt
items.text:
Trigger A creature looks into the mirror

---
Effect The triggering creature sees themselves enjoying their deepest desires in the mirror's reflection, becoming Fascinated (DC 20 Will save negates). This fascination ends automatically when the mirror is broken or covered up.

text: This mirror reflects the viewer's deepest desires.
